title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #7

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah says "Say: He is Allah, the One"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. An-Naas
   D. Al-Kafirun

2. The name Al-Fatiha means (1 mark)
   A. The Victory
   B. The Cow
   C. The Sincerity
   D. The Opening

3. Which surah teaches us to thank Allah and stay humble when we succeed? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Kafirun

4. Who is the best example of good character for Muslims? (1 mark)
   A. A game character
   B. A rich businessman
   C. A film star
   D. Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)

5. "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals." Who narrated this hadith according to the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Hakim
   B. Ibn Majah
   C. Muslim
   D. Abu Lahab

6. Which job did the young Muhammad (S.A.W.) do? (1 mark)
   A. Shepherd and later trader
   B. Blacksmith only
   C. Soldier
   D. Judge

7. Which food is worst for teeth if we do not brush after? (1 mark)
   A. Plain rice
   B. Water
   C. Sweets and sugary drinks
   D. Cabbage

8. What does physical fitness mean? (1 mark)
   A. Having many clothes
   B. A healthy, active and strong body
   C. Eating sweets
   D. Sleeping a lot

9. What does "As-Salam" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Hearing
   B. The Most Merciful
   C. The King
   D. The Source of Peace

10. What is the duty of Raqib and Atid? (1 mark)
   A. To take souls
   B. To blow the Trumpet
   C. To bring rain
   D. To record our deeds

11. Which angel will blow the Trumpet? (1 mark)
   A. Mikail
   B. Atid
   C. Israfil
   D. Jibril

12. What is honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Telling lies
   B. Boasting
   C. Hiding things
   D. Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust

13. Which item may be used together with water in washing a heavy najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Paint
   B. Clean soil
   C. Sugar
   D. Salt

14. Which of these is a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Urine
   B. Milk
   C. Sweat
   D. Clean water

15. What is a mutawassitah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A drink
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A light najasa

16. Which verse commands wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 5:6
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 1:2
   D. Qur'an 112:1

17. Which of these does NOT break wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Eating and drinking
   B. Passing wind
   C. Urine
   D. Deep sleep lying down

18. Which of these can help find prayer times? (1 mark)
   A. Counting stars only
   B. Asking a stranger to guess
   C. Guessing from the weather only
   D. A mosque timetable or the adhan

19. Why do Muslims all over the world face the same direction? (1 mark)
   A. To confuse others
   B. It unites us
   C. For sport
   D. By accident

20. What is the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. A call to prayer
   B. A garment
   C. A prayer mat
   D. The direction of the Kaaba

21. What is the plural of rukn? (1 mark)
   A. Suwar
   B. Sunan
   C. Shuruut
   D. Arkan

22. Who owns all creatures? (1 mark)
   A. Allah
   B. Farmers
   C. The government
   D. Zoos

23. What does the Qur'an say about everything in the heavens and earth? (1 mark)
   A. They are useless
   B. They glorify Allah
   C. They are silent
   D. They ignore Him

24. With which side should we start when putting on shoes? (1 mark)
   A. Either
   B. Left
   C. Right
   D. Neither

25. What does Qur'an 49:6 tell us about news? (1 mark)
   A. Change it
   B. Ignore it
   C. Check it first
   D. Share it quickly

26. What is one reward of being good to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Trouble
   C. Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   D. Loss

27. What should you do when relatives have a quarrel? (1 mark)
   A. Gossip
   B. Forgive and make peace
   C. Spread stories
   D. Take sides in anger

28. Who is a "babu"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandmother
   B. Aunt
   C. Cousin
   D. Grandfather

29. In which month did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Rajab
   B. Shawwal
   C. Ramadan
   D. Muharram

30. What does the Kaaba represent? (1 mark)
   A. A school
   B. A palace
   C. The House built to worship Allah alone
   D. A market

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two. (3 marks)

32. Explain the hadith about keeping family ties and provision. (3 marks)

33. Explain why Muslims do not worship angels. (3 marks)

34. Write the seven surahs studied in this lesson and give the number of verses in any three of them. (5 marks)

35. Describe how a class can show kindness to creatures in the school compound. (4 marks)

36. How can you apply the teaching of Al-Falaq about envy in your daily life? (3 marks)

37. Give three benefits of the Islamic dress code. (3 marks)

38. Explain the meaning of modesty in dressing. (3 marks)

39. Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste. (4 marks)

40. Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin? (3 marks)

41. State three values learned from participating in sports. (3 marks)

42. Give two items used in purification of najasaat. (2 marks)

43. State the duties of Jibril, Mikail and Israfil. (3 marks)

44. Explain the lesson from the story of the man who gave a dog water. (3 marks)

45. What can children do for parents who have passed away? (3 marks)

46. State the hadith of eating that is in your syllabus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Al-Ikhlas
   These are the first words of Al-Ikhlas.

2. D — The Opening
   Al-Fatiha means "The Opening" because it opens the Qur'an.

3. A — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr speaks of victory and tells us to praise Allah and ask forgiveness.

4. D — Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)
   The Qur'an praises his great character.

5. A — Al-Hakim
   The syllabus gives Al-Hakim as the narrator.

6. A — Shepherd and later trader
   He herded sheep and later traded honestly.

7. C — Sweets and sugary drinks
   Sugar feeds germs.

8. B — A healthy, active and strong body
   Fitness means the body is healthy.

9. D — The Source of Peace
   As-Salam is free of all faults and gives peace.

10. D — To record our deeds
   They write what a person says and does.

11. C — Israfil
   Israfil blows the Trumpet by Allah's command.

12. D — Not cheating or stealing and keeping trust
   Honest people are trusted.

13. B — Clean soil
   One of the washings uses soil.

14. A — Urine
   Urine must be washed off before prayer.

15. C — A medium najasa
   Mutawassitah means medium.

16. A — Qur'an 5:6
   Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6.

17. A — Eating and drinking
   Eating does not break wudhu.

18. D — A mosque timetable or the adhan
   These are reliable.

19. B — It unites us
   The Qibla unites Muslims.

20. D — The direction of the Kaaba
   Muslims face the Kaaba.

21. D — Arkan
   Arkan means pillars.

22. A — Allah
   We are caretakers.

23. B — They glorify Allah
   All creation praises Allah.

24. C — Right
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

25. C — Check it first
   Verify before acting.

26. C — Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   It is among the best deeds.

27. B — Forgive and make peace
   Islam teaches forgiveness.

28. D — Grandfather
   Babu means grandfather.

29. C — Ramadan
   The Qur'an began in Ramadan.

30. C — The House built to worship Allah alone
   Ibrahim and Ismail built it.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Whoever wants his provision increased and life extended should keep good relations with relatives. Family ties bring blessing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the two rewards, 1 mark for blessing.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

34. (5 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha (7), Al-Kafirun (6), An-Nasr (3), Al-Masad (5), Al-Ikhlas (4), Al-Falaq (5), An-Naas (6). Any three with correct number of verses.
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for naming all seven (award proportionally), 1 mark for three correct verse counts.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees, put out water for birds, keep the compound clean, do not harm insects and animals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Seek Allah's protection from envy, be happy when others do well, and do not wish harm on them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seeking refuge, 1 mark for being happy for others, 1 mark for not wishing harm.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, dignity and respect, trains modesty and self-control, obedience to Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Modesty is haya. It means covering properly and dressing decently without showing off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for haya, 1 mark for covering, 1 mark for not showing off.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Teamwork, sharing, humility, fair play, discipline, leadership.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each value.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water, soil, soap, clean cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brings revelation, Mikail is in charge of rain and provision, Israfil will blow the Trumpet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: A small act of kindness can earn Allah's forgiveness and reward, and there is reward in serving every living creature.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for forgiveness, 1 mark for all creatures.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make dua for them, give charity on their behalf, keep good relations with their friends and relatives.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat what is directly in front of you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first two teachings and 1 mark for the third, or 1 mark each for correct halves.
